prompt: In a sunlit anime style library reading room, a girl with pink twin-tails sits on the left side of a long oak table, her posture slumped in exhaustion. Next to her rests a thick blue hardcover book, its spine cracked from use. Across from her, a boy with round glasses leans forward intently, pointing at a diagram in an open textbook. Beside him stands a tall librarian in a green vest, handing a small white card to a shy student with messy brown hair. In the center of the room, a fluffy calico cat sleeps peacefully on a wooden chair, ignoring the bustle around it. To the right, an elderly man in a tweed cap looks at a floating dust mote dancing in the light beam. Behind him, a young woman with a yellow ribbon ties her shoelace while kneeling on the floor. Near the window, a potted fern sits on a sill, its leaves vibrant against the glass. A silver pocket watch lies open on the table near the girl with pink twin-tails, its hands frozen in time. Finally, a stack of three red journals balances precariously on the edge of the desk next to the boy with round glasses. There is no digital technology visible in this serene space. There is no food or drink present on any surface.
